module.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Backend
module.description: Three single-model Bedrock shim pods (Nova Micro, Nova Lite, Claude 3 Haiku) behind a BNK Gateway + HTTPRoute. F5BigAnalyzer CR weights traffic using real Prometheus metrics from the shims (vllm:* shape, matches the builtin LLMLoadMonitor script).

required.reason: BNK Gateway depends on the bnk-gatewayclass being registered

optional.reason: External VLAN must be attached for the Gateway VIP to be reachable

required.name: bedrock_role_arn
required.description: IAM role ARN with bedrock:InvokeModel on the three model foundation-model ARNs, trusting the EKS OIDC provider + this module's ServiceAccount. See README for creation snippet.

required.name: gateway_vip
required.description: IPv4 VIP for the BNK Gateway. Must be in the external VLAN's prefix and unused.

optional.name: aws_region
optional.description: AWS region Bedrock calls are routed to. Pre-check model availability per region.

optional.name: models
optional.description: Map of backend name → { model_id, weight }. Weights should sum to 100.

optional.name: prometheus_release_label
optional.description: Value of the 'release' label matched by Prometheus operator's serviceMonitorSelector

key_outputs.name: gateway_name
key_outputs.description: BNK Gateway name — client module targets this

key_outputs.name: gateway_url
key_outputs.description: Full base URL (http://<vip>) clients POST chat completions to — wired into client module's gateway_url

key_outputs.name: gateway_vip
key_outputs.description: The VIP the client should POST to

key_outputs.name: httproute_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the HTTPRoute whose backendRefs the analyzer weights
